description: This file defines a TRPC router for managing feature opt-in settings, including listing, checking eligibility, and setting feature states for users, teams, and organizations. It also handles auto opt-in preferences.

methods.name: listForUser
methods.description: Retrieves all opt-in features with their states for the current user, considering all teams and organizations the user belongs to.

methods.name: listForTeam
methods.description: Retrieves all opt-in features with their states for a specific team, including parent organization info if available.

methods.name: listForOrganization
methods.description: Retrieves all opt-in features with their states for an organization.

methods.name: checkFeatureOptInEligibility
methods.description: Checks if the current user is eligible to opt-in to a specific feature.

methods.name: setUserState
methods.description: Sets the feature state for the current user.

methods.name: setTeamState
methods.description: Sets the feature state for a team (requires team admin).

methods.name: setOrganizationState
methods.description: Sets the feature state for an organization (requires org admin).

methods.name: getUserAutoOptIn
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's auto opt-in preference.

methods.name: setUserAutoOptIn
methods.description: Sets the current user's auto opt-in preference.

methods.name: getTeamAutoOptIn
methods.description: Retrieves auto opt-in preference for a team (requires team admin).

methods.name: setTeamAutoOptIn
methods.description: Sets auto opt-in preference for a team (requires team admin).

methods.name: getOrganizationAutoOptIn
methods.description: Retrieves auto opt-in preference for an organization (requires org admin).

methods.name: setOrganizationAutoOptIn
methods.description: Sets auto opt-in preference for an organization (requires org admin).
